LESSON: READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE READING – OGRE STORIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we read to get specific information from a text?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the features of ogre stories for information
2. respond to questions from texts for comprehension
3. use vocabulary related to the theme in sentence construction for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE READING – OGRE STORIES
This lesson teaches Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories for Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

1. identify the features of ogre stories for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. use vocabulary related to the theme in sentence construction for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories above.
2. Explain Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 8.2.1 Intensive reading – Ogre stories important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we read to get specific information from a text?
2. How do ogre stories differ from other stories?
